svg.title: Givn change lifecycle: proposal to archive
svg.desc: Top-to-bottom flow: an optional ideation entry (domain-driven event storming) feeds phase 1; each action pill creates the artifact shown to its right; check cards between the actions gate the transition. Advisory checks never block; every other check must pass before the next action starts.

g.text: givn — change lifecycle: proposal to archive
One action per row, the artifact it creates to its right. Every check between rows
multi-session storm: domain events, personas, use cases, change seeds
hands off to propose — creates no chain artifact
WHAT and WHY, domain language, no implementation detail
deterministic duplicate and coverage reports over the permanent corpus
syntax · @wip tags · overlap warnings (severity-ranked exit code)
↩ runs again as a blocking built-in hook at every gate
HOW to implement, config, e2e infrastructure
plan stress-tested one question at a time, then hardened
file must end with “DESIGN-REVIEW: PASS” — otherwise partial;
setup task first, then RED / GREEN / REFACTOR / COMMIT
@wip gate: no scenario may remain work in progress
one targeted TDD cycle per scenario, one atomic commit
RED must exit non-zero (exit 0 = hard stop) ·
GREEN and REFACTOR must exit zero
coverage gap classification, fabrication audit, overlap dispositions
verify suite → verify-e2e anti-bypass → integrity (commit hashes, promised files)
shape matches involving the delta are dispositioned
every uncovered line classified (dead code / missing test / justified)
deltas merged into permanent specs, @givn.* stripped,
required artifacts complete · PASS markers present · hooks green ·
merge validated against the recorded narrative base revisions
verify suite (+ e2e) against merged specs · coverage addon gate —
any failure leaves the candidate unproven and repairable forward
